ResponsesReasoningInputItem.note: Canonical typed replay requires id and summary; optional reasoning_text content, encrypted_content, status and beta agent metadata. Dispatches from Item.fromJson and ResponseInput.items. Reasoning remains a distinct item rather than assistant text.

ResponsesReasoningOutputItem.note: Existing output model gains typed input conversion and preserves returned status. Existing const construction remains; replay conversion snapshots caller-owned content and summary. Full content equality/hash and redacted diagnostics are checked.

ResponsesReasoningSummaryContent.note: Existing summary scalar value reused for canonical reasoning replay; type summary_text and text string remain distinct from reasoning_text.

ResponsesReasoningTextContent.note: Existing public OutputContent reasoning_text value model. Reasoning replay uses validated raw-map content with the same required type/text fields, preserving future metadata keys rather than flattening it into assistant text.
